svg.title: Why small and large apertures can each improve image quality
svg.desc: Comparison of geometrical defocus blur, which grows with aperture diameter, and focused diffraction blur, which shrinks with aperture diameter.
svg.text: Section 4.4: the aperture conclusions use different limits
Same aperture diameter D; different focus condition and different blur mechanism
